text.name: Shanghai Five
text.rules: Record "entente formed". SAE spends 2 points on one action. At the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan formed the Shanghai Five at a summit on 26 April 1996; with Uzbekistan they founded the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation on 15 June 2001.
